meta.name: memory-search
meta.description: Search memory by frontmatter fields, full-text keywords, or cross-reference graph. Returns ranked file list — never loads full content. Use when the agent needs to find relevant memory without knowing exact paths.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从笔记中快速查找信息
copy.tagline_en: Search memory files to quickly find relevant content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find information from your notes

howto.what: Claude能通过三种模式搜索记忆文件：按frontmatter字段（如领域、标签）、按全文关键词、或按引用关系查找，返回排名文件列表（路径、标题、片段），从不加载完整内容。
howto.when: 当你需要查找相关记忆但不知道具体文件路径、领域或决策ID时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude can search memory files in three modes: by frontmatter fields (e.g., domain, tags), by full-text keywords, or by cross-reference relationships. Returns a ranked list of file paths, titles, and excerpts, never loading full content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find relevant memory without knowing the exact file path, domain, or DEC ID.
